title: 雙重圖案化製程
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究分解與配色、曝光與轉移、誤差分配、整合比較；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: decomposition and coloring, exposure and transfer, error allocation, integration comparison. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.descriptionEn: Double patterning partitions patterns into subsets that can be processed separately.

steps.title: 將密集線分成兩種顏色
steps.titleEn: Split dense lines into two colors
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：每個子集合的間距可大於最終間距。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Each subset can have larger pitch than the final pattern.

steps.instructionEn: Split dense lines into two colors. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Each subset can have larger pitch than the final pattern.
steps.observation: 每個子集合的間距可大於最終間距。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Each subset can have larger pitch than the final pattern. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「只需把曝光時間加倍。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Simply double the exposure time.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「將密集線分成兩種顏色」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「每個子集合的間距可大於最終間距。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「雙重圖案化製程」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「將密集線分成兩種顏色」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：兩次曝光各自合格仍可能因相對套刻而失敗。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「黃光任務：解析度、套刻與缺陷」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：雙重圖案化製程 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「兩次曝光各自合格仍可能因相對套刻而失敗」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Double-patterning lithography as the task boundary. After reading “Split dense lines into two colors”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Two individually passing exposures can fail through relative overlay. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Yellow-light mission: resolution, overlay and defects”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Double-patterning lithography: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Two individually passing exposures can fail through relative overlay” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 完成「將密集線分成兩種顏色」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Split dense lines into two colors", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 每個子集合的間距可大於最終間距。
所有雙重圖案化都沒有套刻需求。
optionsEn: Each subset can have larger pitch than the final pattern.
All double patterning eliminates overlay requirements.
quiz.explanation: 每個子集合的間距可大於最終間距。 雙重圖案化把難以單次解析的圖形拆成可處理的子集合。
quiz.explanationEn: Each subset can have larger pitch than the final pattern. Double patterning partitions patterns into subsets that can be processed separately.
